173172.description:
The anarchy continues as Caiman inches closer to the truth behind his cursed appearance and the mystery around the Cross-Eyes' boss begins to unravel.

(Source: Netflix Anime)
synonyms: สาปพันธุ์อสูร ซีซั่น2

173174.description: Compilation film of BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!. The first of the Bandori MyGO compilation movie duology.
synonyms: 劇場版 BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! 前編

title.native: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! 春の陽だまり、迷い猫
title.romaji: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!: Haru no Hidamari, Mayoi Neko

173216.description:
An anime adapting Gakken's children's book series Sai-Kyo-Oh! Zukan. The series pits animals and dinosaurs against each other in a tournament.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

173240.description:
After finding himself reincarnated into the world of a novel, Loneal goes to great lengths to steer clear of Prince Alec, the hero, to avoid disrupting the main storyline between Alec and the heroine, Lily. However, to Loneal's great surprise, the prince becomes infatuated with...him?!

"A charming physique, such as yours, more than makes up for your lack of experience."

Before he knows it, he finds himself melting into the prince's arms... Why is everything so different from the novel?!

Note: Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on March 15th, 2024. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
synonyms: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, His Rival?!
Le prince parfait m'aime, moi, son rival!?
O Príncipe encantado se apaixonou por mim, um mero coadjuvante?
¿¡El príncipe perfecto me ama, el personaje secundario!?

title.english: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, the Side Character?!
title.native: 当て馬キャラのくせして、スパダリ王子に寵愛されています。
title.romaji: Ateuma Chara no Kuse Shite, Supadari Ouji ni Chouai Sareteimasu.

173244.description:
Leo is a boy genius inventor. Aquro is a water type Elemon (H2O) created by Leo. Elemon are creatures born from the Elemon Blender. They are mysterious beings with the power of the elements! “ELEMON” opens up an exciting world of science and adventure, anchored by the friendship of Leo and Aquro as they explore an entire universe of unique Elemon!

(Source: Toei Animation)

173249.description:
The anime will be an "action-comedy" that sees Kumarba and Tabris facing off against Bagurin, who is wreaking havoc on the online world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

173250.description: A planet inhabited by creatures that never see the light of day. There's nothing to be proud of, but that's okay.

173254.description:
TV shows, manga, music, movies, plays, pop stars and cartoon characters. I watch videos on my phone with the TV blaring and music in the background. I’m swimming in media… Is this the other side of the screen?! Awesome!

1st year work 2021, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.

(Source: Geidai Animation)

173255.description:
That moment of refreshing sensation when drinking a soda in the hot summer.

1st year work 2021, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.

(Source: Geidai Animation)

173263.description:
Money, women, organs. Kei, a high school boy, frequents the underground mahjong parlor teeming with desires, earning him the moniker 'K of Ice' in the underworld due to his cold-hearted strategy and stylish gameplay. Rumors also circulate that he keeps a girl at his home.

(Source: Pony Canyon)

title.english: Tohai - Ura Rate Mahjong Tohai Roku
title.native: 凍牌～裏レート麻雀闘牌録～
title.romaji: Touhai: Ura Rate Mahjong Touhai Roku

173264.description: A Minna no Uta music video animated by Fumio Ooi. It has no relation to the Minna no Uta music video from 2004 which also has the same name.

173265.description: Music video for the song Sora to Umi no Komoriuta by Masaaki Sakai that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

173287.description: Music video directed and animated by Masaaki Tanaka for the song Intergalactic Bound by Yunosuke and CircusP featuring vocals by Hatsune Miku. This original theme song and corresponding video is to commemorate the 10th anniversary of MIKU EXPO.

173295.description:
Kobato decides to become an honest, humble citizen after enduring a bitter experience known as “wisdom work.” He forms a pact with Osanai, his classmate with the same goal, and they plan to enter high school leading quiet lives. But for some reason, inexplicable events and disasters keep happening around them. Will Kobato and Osanai ever manage to live ordinary, peaceful lives?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

173311.description: New short film by Saku Sakamoto announced during the screening of Amrita no Kyouen.

173313.description: New Atashin'chi anime to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the manga.

173333.description:
A new entry in the Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru series, in which the main character, fourth grader Wataru Hoshibe, appears as a RyuTuber aiming to become a superstar, and battles with his partner Ryuujinmaru in an alternate world of floating blocks to defeat the last boss “Enjoda”.

(Source: Oricon, translated)
synonyms: วาตารุ ผู้สร้างเทพจักรกล

173334.description: Announced at Touken Ranbu Online Ninth Anniversary's Eve! Nine Big Announcements Starting at Nine.

173335.description:
Seven years after humanity was devastated by a major disaster, a beacon of science and prosperity rises in Kamitsubaki City. But lurking in its shadows are Tesseractor, monsters born from human darkness. Only the Witchling, five girls with voices that wield magic, stand against them. With every note, they fight, not just to protect the peace of the city, but to heal a broken world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Notes:
• Announced in the "Kamitsubaki Yoyogi Kessen 2024: V.W.P 2nd ONE-MAN LIVE - Genshou II" Day 1 concert.
• Includes Episode 0.

173346.description: Music video for the song Kakenukete Good-bye by B'dash that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

173347.description: Music video for the song Mahou no Crayon by Yuu Aihara that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

173348.description: Music video for the song Aozora to Tap Dance by Ikue Sakakibara that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

173388.description:
Naoe-kun, a massage therapist, is about to head home for the day when he’s saddled with a rather strange patient. This lovely lady has emerald eyes, pointy ears, and grew up in the forest–everything about her screams “elf,” except for one thing: her bodacious body. It turns out she left her world but loves junk food in this one, and now her obsession has caught up with her. Can Naoe-kun help this lovable elf girl lose the weight–and keep it off?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Elf can't be on a diet.

title.native: エルフさんは痩せられない。

173441.description:
An anime version of Ikkei Makina's horror novel of the same name. It aired at the same time as the live-action adaptation.

(Source: aniDB)
synonyms: Sho is Flying in the Sky

173489.description:
The story begins when Kazuto's childhood friend and model Yayoi asks to stay at his apartment without any explanation. Kazuto often sees Yayoi go out with a guy after leaving his apartment, and idly wonders why she won't stay at his place. One night, Yayoi asks Kazuto to not come home until morning after the graveyard shift at his part time job ends, since Yayoi is inviting a friend over. Kazuto guesses that she is bringing home a man to have sex with. When his suspicions prove true, a new relationship between them begins.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

Note: Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on June 14th, 2024. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
synonyms: Habiter dans une chambre de baise!

173523.description:
Futami, a novice shojo manga artist, is finally publishing her beloved shogi manga, Dear Subaru. But…the stress makes her stomach hurt, she’s forced to push the deadline for her first chapter, and she isn’t making any progress on the storyboards. To top it off, she’s gaining weight from midnight snacking and starts having wild delusions! Will Futami be able to enjoy life as a manga artist?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: A Workplace Where You Can't Help But Smile

title.native: 笑顔のたえない職場です。

173533.description:
The sequel to the 'Final Season' story arc of the Monogatari series.

From the past to the future, their story continues.

Now that he has graduated from high school, Koyomi Araragi’s story ends here. His story is truly over now, but the stories of the girls Koyomi saved - their stories - are not over yet.

This is the prequel or sequel to their stories and their struggles.

(Source: Monogatari Series USA Official Website)

title.native: 〈物語〉シリーズ オフ&モンスターシーズン

173534.description: Special episode of Odekake Kozame collabing with Kuro Ajillo.

title.native: おでかけ子ザメ × 千葉県 黒アヒージョ

173549.description: Music video directed by Takara Donburi for the song non-reflection by Aiobahn featuring Yui Makino.

173584.description:
Ike is a powerful magician and the leader of the Immortal Brigade, part of the Seventh Corps of the Demon Lord’s Army. He single-handedly conquers fortresses and pushes back the armies of humanity. Neither Dairokuten, the Demon Lord, nor Ike’s loyal soldiers know his darkest secret—he is a human in hiding! But can he keep his secret safe and bring peaceful coexistence to demons and humans?

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: Maou-gun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta

title.english: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army was a Human
title.native: 魔王軍最強の魔術師は人間だった
title.romaji: Maou Gun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta

173639.description: New Ensemble Stars!! web animated series based on the game story "Checkmate".

title.native: あんさんぶるスターズ！！追憶セレクション「チェックメイト」

173640.description: Short animation shown during the 2nd year anniversary stream for NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE.
synonyms: NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE ショートアニメ「ある日の午後」

173647.description: Amabie saved people from a plague during the Edo period. In the chaotic Reiwa era, she reappears on earth and saves people one after another with his unconventional activities!? A surreal and cynical one-shot anime! The cast is participating one after another from the world of influencers and livers who are leading the times!!

173692.description:
Ellen, an 8-year-old girl and half-spirit, once lived as a scientist in modern-day Japan. Now she’s been reincarnated into a new family: Rovel, her father and the kingdom’s legendary hero, and Origin, her mother and the queen of spirits. On top of that, Ellen herself has the power to manipulate chemical elements! But are Ellen’s powers enough to protect their family’s happiness?

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: Reincarnated as the Daughter of the Legendary Hero and the Queen of Spirits
My Father is a Hero, my Mother is a Spirit and the Daughter (Me) is a Reincarnator.
Dad Is a Hero, Mom Is a Spirit, I'm a Reincarnator
ป๊ะป๋าผู้กล้า มาม้าเป็นเทพธิดา ส่วนหนูกลับมาเกิดใหม่พลังแต้มพิกัด

title.english: Dad is a Hero, Mom is a Spirit, I'm a Reincarnator
title.native: 父は英雄、母は精霊、娘の私は転生者。
title.romaji: Chichi wa Eiyuu, Haha wa Seirei, Musume no Watashi wa Tenseisha.

173693.description:
Haruka has been living his high school life as a loner, but all of a sudden, he and his classmates are summoned into another world. A God gives him a list of skills he can freely pick... Or at least that was how it was supposed to be, as all the valuable skills have been taken by the other classmates first. After Haruka scolded God, he snapped back and gave all the remaining bad skills to Haruka. Thanks to the "Loner" skill, Haruka begins his lonely adventure in another world.

(Source: Muse Asia)

Note: Each episode streamed a week early on some streaming services. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2024.

title.native: ひとりぼっちの異世界攻略

173694.description:
Touka always faded into the background at school. And when he’s summoned to another world with his classmates, that still doesn’t change! They all acquire top-rank skills, except Touka, who’s deemed a failure and cast to ancient ruins by the goddess Vicius. Turns out, his low-rank skills may not be so useless after all. Now, he seeks revenge against the goddess, and his true nature is revealed.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: Dengan Bingkai Status Sampah "Skill Abnormal" Aku Menjadi Terkuat dan Akan Menghabisi Semuanya

title.english: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything with Low-Level Spells
title.native: ハズレ枠の【状態異常スキル】で最強になった俺がすべてを蹂躙するまで
title.romaji: Hazure Waku no [Joutai Ijou Skill] de Saikyou ni Natta Ore ga Subete wo Juurin Suru made

173780.description:
As Naofumi prepares for the Phoenix’s return, assassins from Q’ten Lo target Raphtalia, mistaking her for a throne usurper. To resolve the conflict, Naofumi journeys to Siltvelt, where he is hailed as a demi-human savior, but not all welcome him. In politically volatile Q’ten Lo, Raphtalia becomes a revolutionary symbol. Amid rising chaos, can Naofumi unite his allies and guide them to salvation?

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

title.english: The Rising of the Shield Hero Season 4
title.native: 盾の勇者の成り上がり Season 4
title.romaji: Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari Season 4

173807.description:
A short film directed by You Yoshinari created for Lotte's chocolate business' 60th anniversary.

The spell to make chocolate delicious: "Chocolat Cadabra"

Set in a late-night chocolate factory, three girls go on a grand adventure as they traverse the worlds of science, magic, and reality. Chocolate has and will continue to add excitement to our lives. Tonight, somewhere in a chocolate factory, someone is surely chanting a "spell to make chocolate delicious.'' Chocolat Cadabra!

(Source: Official Site, translated)

Note: This entry is for the longer "Full Version" shown on the official website and Ado's YouTube channel on Jan 31, 2024. A 30-second "Short" and 60-second "Long" version were released on Jan 21, 2024 and Jan 22, 2024 respectively.

173824.description: The second season of Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori. Rather than adapting the storybooks, this season focuses on an anime original arc of Puppe's search for the Minus Eel and Zorori's battle with The Legendary Prank King.
synonyms: Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori Zekkouchou-hen
まじめにふまじめ かいけつゾロリ ゼッコーチョー編
まじめにふまじめ かいけつゾロリ2

title.native: まじめにふまじめ かいけつゾロリ ゼッコーチョー！
title.romaji: Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori: Zekkouchou!

173884.description:
The story begins with the emergence of the first high-tech molcar in Molcity, with drivers beginning to ride state-of-the-art AI-driven Molcars. Potato and friends get involved in a chase between a mysterious organization and a Molcar AI named Canon, and are saved by a talented driver. Potato finds out that the driver is in search of his missing Molcar, and gets the idea to use Canon's AI functionality to help with the search.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
173884.hashtag: #モルカー #ムービーモルカー #MOLMAX

title.native: PUI PUI モルカー ザ・ムービー MOLMAX
title.romaji: PUI PUI Molcar the Movie MOLMAX

173935.description:
The film's story begins when a high schooler who makes music videos meets a teacher who has given up on music. Amateur music video creator Kanata Asaya sees teacher and musician Yuu Orie busking on the street, and decides to make a music video of her music.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

173956.description: The tagline of the project is, "…Rock is a story of grief and hope." The story depicts the dedication and drive of four bands under the Rhapsody label: the four-member rock band Pink Flag with personal trauma, the loud rock band Haru no Juujika (Spring Cross) of high school students, the folk unit Bluebird composed of childhood friends, and the EDM brother duo System of Romance (SOR).
